chain.label: Pitting corrosion in actuator housing
chain.trigger: pitting corrosion along the retainer ring groove corners on the interior of the actuator housing

chain.label: Stress concentration at retainer ring groove
chain.trigger: the geometry of the housing where the retainer ring is located may impart a high stress concentration at the area of fatigue crack initiation

chain.label: Hydraulic actuator housing fracture and fluid loss
chain.trigger: fatigue cracks initiated from pitting corrosion, propagated outward into the housing, and when they grew large enough, the housing fractured, resulting in loss of hydraulic fluid

caused_by.evidence: pitting corrosion along the retainer ring groove corners acting as sites for fatigue crack initiation
the geometry of the housing may impart a high stress concentration at the area of fatigue crack initiation

chain.label: Landing gear actuator failure and collapse
chain.trigger: loss of hydraulic fluid leading to the actuator failing in service, resulting in the main landing gear failing to fully extend or collapsing at touchdown

caused_by.evidence: loss of hydraulic fluid leading to the actuator failing in service

chain.label: Emergency gear-up landing or landing gear collapse
chain.trigger: emergency gear-up landing or the landing gear collapsing at touchdown

caused_by.evidence: the main landing gear failed to fully extend, resulting in either an emergency gear-up landing or the landing gear collapsing at touchdown
